answers.core: As I say above, you would need to recompile the no-editor build in a way that matches what you want. Maybe you can do it with an add-on, but it really would optimize if it was on its core.
answers.workaround: As I've tried to learn about it, I saw that you would need to enter into the core of the engine. Even with a plugin, you would need to recompile the no-editor build anyway.
